text: A tortoise plods along at 0.3 km an hour. How long does it take to cover 1.5 km?
A koala sleeps 20 hours a day. How many hours is it awake in a week?
On a seesaw, a 30 kg child sits 2 metres from the middle. How far from the middle must a 60 kg adult sit on the other side to balance?
why: Twice the weight needs half the distance: 30 × 2 = 60 × 1.
